path_conventions.patch: Basename under this recipe's patches directory.
path_conventions.changed_paths: Paths relative to the component source root, in bundled diff-header order.
path_conventions.regression_tests: Paths relative to the SparkRing repository root; these verify packaging, not serving correctness.
path_conventions.component_regression_tests: Paths relative to the component source root, present in the bundled patch; execute after applying the pinned composition.

scope: Records bundled integration intent and existing test locations. It does not establish upstream acceptance, test execution or hardware qualification.

vllm.purpose: Preserve GLM token-sharded mHC prefill, recurrent-checkpoint coalescing and external-cache recovery interfaces in the pinned R35 vLLM source composition.
integrations_preserved: Token-sharded mHC prefill admission and deferred projection/MoE reductions with explicit residual and auxiliary-output ownership.
Coalesced fresh and continuation prefill with planned recurrent checkpoint boundaries propagated through scheduler and worker metadata.
Hybrid external-cache recovery and CUDA VMM connector capability checks, including SparkCache integration boundaries.
KDA convolution checkpoint history excludes speculative cells; checkpoint binding follows planned request metadata.

b12x.purpose: Provide transactional multi-checkpoint KDA prefill exports and GB10 admission policy required by the vLLM recurrent-checkpoint composition.
integrations_preserved: Two- and four-checkpoint recurrent-state export with final running-state preservation.
Checkpoint destination, count, offset and alias validation before mutating output state.
Explicit GB10 multi-checkpoint activation and capability/query schema checks.
GPU kernel and CPU reference behavior checked against independent prefix recurrences, including frozen replay and high pool offsets.
